risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (295), FOMC decision in 1 day creates imminent event risk, and financial sector faces credit stress; earnings in 36 days adds secondary uncertainty.

debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, FOMC decision in 1 day), zero fundamental catalysts, momentum divergence (MACD negative, OBV non-confirming), and imminent earnings risk in 36 days outweigh technical structure.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — weak entry; stock equidistant from support (101.07) and resistance (105.01) with no clear directional conviction despite technical setup
